label: proxy-0.567-cross-type
_what_it_means: the cell's device-waiting arm used DEVICE_ANSWER_CHARGE_S = 0.567 s, a ROBOT RECALL latency (StudyD8 arm A), as its live wait for DASHCAM instants and SINGLE-SHOT questions as well as robot questions. Both live sites are decision timing (coordinator.py, the served_at charge and the earliest-act gate), so the arm acted on a schedule set by a number measured on a different task type.
_scale: for confidence-cascade on a 300 s 16-device cell, 14,118 of 14,201 device-wait lookups were dashcam instants and 79 were single-shot questions, against 4 robot questions. So the cross-type proxy governed over 99.9 percent of the wait, not a corner case.
_register: PRE-EXISTING in the committed code; not introduced by the measured-wait work, and it is precisely why the first Step 2b comparison showed zero movement. Raised rather than silently patched, because choosing a dashcam device wait is a measurement, not an implementation detail.
_resolution: measured tables now exist and are wired (results/device/study_devlat/orin_device_latency_tables.json): dashcam EP-G warm-append first token by episode position (0.2349 s at 1 frame to 0.3169 s at 21), and single-shot completion per question (1,042 questions). The fallback counter is 0 on all four arms, so cells run from here carry no proxy.
headline_rule: no cell in this list may feed a headline comparison. They remain valid only as pre-measured-wait sensitivity, and any table citing them must carry the proxy-0.567-cross-type label.
thinking_qwenvl_note: not a registered live2 arm at all: arms.make_arm('thinking-qwenvl') raises 'unknown arm'. It appears in the scorer's cascade list but was never ported, so it can neither be run nor released. Flagged rather than left to surface later.
